acceptances.justification: The service owner approved a seven-day acceptance on 2026-10-01 for this measured ARM64 image and this package only. Debian still lists GCC 14 as unfixed; verified DHI VEX does not suppress this CVE. This is not a remediation or a not_affected claim.
acceptances.impact: GCC's libstdc++ PBDS binary-heap erase_if can retain a freed entry pointer after reallocating storage, causing a process crash or memory corruption when invoked. Grype associates this GCC-source CVE with this installed binary package; the package match alone does not prove service reachability.
acceptances.exploitability: Use of the affected C++ template by every bundled native dependency has not been ruled out. Non-root execution, a read-only root filesystem and the absence of arbitrary-code execution features constrain exposure but do not remove memory-corruption risk.
acceptances.evidence: CI https://github.com/pitekusu/shittim-chest/actions/runs/36851626558 supplied the measured production digest, final ARM64 SBOM, raw Grype report and signature-verified DHI VEX report. Installed version: 14.2.0-19+dhi3; residual severity: High; fix state: not-fixed. Debian: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-102010 ; upstream fix: https://github.com/gcc-mirror/gcc/commit/aaa8351f4d2e636f9680a1f0a8ebc2f0a60611e6 .
acceptances.reevaluation_conditions: Reevaluate on expiry, any image digest, package, native dependency or exposure change, a Debian/DHI fix, new exploitability evidence, or verified vendor VEX. Remove a superseded acceptance; any changed digest needs fresh SBOM, scan and VEX review. Do not extend automatically. Fixable High/Critical and other unaccepted residual findings remain blocking.
